source: figure captions and surrounding full-text context

argumentation_roles.lesson: Use a small number of mechanism/setup figures to establish WLAN access and model flow before metrics.
Heatmaps and predictive importance can motivate feature selection but must not be upgraded to causal influence.
Many near-duplicate model-by-model CDF plots should be consolidated into a common-axis comparison or small multiples.

argumentation_roles.role: classification learning curves and metric dashboards
argumentation_roles.lesson: For imbalanced MCS/NSS, accuracy must be shown alongside macro/per-class F1, precision, recall and support.
Marginal MCS/NSS distributions do not verify structured pair validity; add a valid-pair matrix and invalid-pair count.
